segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with severe hyperpigmentation, report the cleanser rinses off without leaving skin feeling dry or stripped.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin reports no breakouts from this oil-based cleanser and noticed her nose pores looking smaller and less clogged.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several who are also acne-prone or normally reactive to harsh cleansers, consistently report no irritation, redness, or new breakouts, and some say it succeeded where their usual cleansers were too harsh.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the cleanser leaves skin soft and hydrated rather than dry, tight, or stripped, including several who say their usual cleansers dry their skin out but this one doesn't.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no redness, rash, or irritation from this cleanser, including some who normally react to harsher formulas.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the cleanser leaves a moisturizing layer that acts as a protective barrier, keeping her skin from drying out after washing.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with severe hyperpigmentation reports her skin is in the best condition she's had, though she also added other topical products alongside this cleanser around the same time.

extraits.titre: Seems to work okay but feels greasy
extraits.texte: I use a lot of Elta products but my face wash I use normally is by Drunk Elephant. I bought this for travel as the size is small enough to take on a plane. It has an oily feel to it and doesn't seem to leave my skin as clean as my Drunk Elephant.

extraits.titre: Oily gentle cleanser for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: The EltaMD Oil-In-Gel Face Cleanser is a translucent gel that is unscented. Per instruction on the box, applied this onto dry skin, and tried to massage around, however, it was not that easy to do as this gel feels like silicone at contact, and it does not "transform into oil" to spread easily. I feel like I am rubbing my skin to spread it. It feels oily on the face. Adding water did make it easier to massage the skin, but it did not generate much milky emulsion as advised. After rinsing, it left a thin oily feel, the skin feels ok and hydrated after patting dry. This is a very gentle cleanser, it feels more like a makeup remover due to the oily quality and finish. I think that improvement in the texture, and viscosity will be better for application.

I love this product! I have very sensitive skin and it did not cause any additional breakouts. My only complaint is that I have eyelash extensions and obviously anything with oil can negative affect those. I have come up with a solution and since that it’s been great. I use this with the morning duo and, it is a quick fast routine for good skin care .

I recieved the .1 ounce tiny sampler a month ago from my esthetician. Oh my goodness. I used that little sampler for 30 days. Just the tiniest dot on wet skin is all you need. I loved how my skin felt after washing. I splurged and purchased the full size tube once I ran out of the sample. BEST DECISION EVER. My skin: 40s, African American, dry, severe hyperpigmentation on lower half of face, winter in cold climate. My skin LOVES this cleanser. We added a couple other topicals to my routine and my skin is in the best condition ever! This was just the skincare foundation I needed to get my skin on track.

extraits.titre: Amazing cleaners for removing make up!
extraits.texte: I was recommended this product by a friend who is an esthetician, and it has been a game changer. I wasn’t sure if I liked it at first but it’s been about a week now and it’s worked beautifully for removing my make up (mostly mascara) at night. It’s gentle and doesn’t feel like it’s stripping / drying out your skin. Your skin feels soft and hydrated after using it. I’ve also noticed my nose pores becoming smaller and less clogged which is a bonus! I have combination skin, and this didn’t cause me to break out at all since it’s an oil based cleaner.

My sister is a PA at a dermatologist office and recommended this to me. I have sensitive skin and most cleansers are too harsh for my skin, on top of drying it out. This product however has helped clear my skin! Apply it onto a dry face, and then add water! Rub in circles and rinse with a clean towel!

This EltaMD Oil-In-Gel Face Cleanser is an interesting product. It cleanses my face like my usual face wash, but leaves a moisturizing protective layer after rinsing. This acts as a protective barrier keeping my skin from drying out after washing. My skin is sensitive and tends to be acne prone whenever I use oily products, but I haven't had any irritation or breakouts from using this so far. In addition to liking the effectiveness of this gel cleanser, I also appreciate that it came well packaged with a safety seal under the flip-up cap. The package is also labeled with an expiration date over 2.5 years away. I'm very satisfied using this EltaMD Oil-In-Gel Face Cleanser and would order it again.
